Additionally, each piece of '''Tarantula Armor''' has a unique piece bonus:
* The {{Item|Tarantula Helmet}}'s {{AN|Radioactive}} perk grants {{Stat|cd|+1}} per {{Stat|str|10}}, up to {{Stat|cd|+100}} at {{Stat|str|1000}}.
* The {{Item|Tarantula Chestplate}}'s {{AN|Anti-Toxin}} perk reduces the effectiveness of {{CollectionLink|Tarantula Broodfather}}'s {{Statname|Vitality}} reduction by {{Green|25%}}.
* The {{Item|Tarantula Leggings}}' {{AN|Brood}} perk increases the base stats of the {{Item|Tarantula Pet}} by {{Green|50%}}.
** This comes out to {{Stat|str|5}}, {{Stat|cc|5}}, and {{Stat|cd|15}} if the {{Item|Tarantula Pet}} is level {{Green|100}}.
* The {{Item|Tarantula Boots}}' {{AN|Double Jump}} ability allows the player to double jump in mid-air, costing {{Stat|mana|40}}.

== Skins ==
{{Item Skins|Tarantula Helmet}}

== Tips ==
* The '''Tarantula Helmet''' is commonly used in place of other armor sets' helmets, due to {{AN|Radioactive}} granting a hefty damage buff for a large section of the game. It is often paired with the armors that give high strength such as {{Item|Shadow Assassin Armor}}, {{Item|Necron's Armor}} and {{Item|Crimson Armor}}.

== Trivia ==
*'''Tarantula Armor''' is one of 9 armor pieces which have the darkest color, with a hex code of {{Color Display|#000000}}. The others are {{Item|Bat Person Armor}}, {{Item|Obsidian Chestplate}}, {{Item|Squid Boots}}, {{Item|Shadow Assassin Armor}}, {{Item|Rancher's Boots}}, {{Item|Necromancer Lord Chestplate}}, {{Item|Snorkeling Armor}} and {{Item|Wither Armor}}.
